response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured full-stack and systems engineer with strong craftsmanship credentials, but his background is almost entirely hands-on product/infrastructure engineering rather than AI strategy, cloud platform vision, or executive-level customer advisory work. His AI-specific exposure is limited to a few months of MCP/agentic tooling work at his current role, with no track record of building recognized AI products, advising strategic partners, or operating at a director/principal strategic level.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Demonstrated technical breadth (D, TypeScript, C/C++, cloud tooling) and open-source leadership (GISCollective)
Recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at current role
concerns: No evidence of AI/ML specialization, advanced degree, or recognized AI expertise/products
Career has been individual-contributor engineering roles, not strategic advisory or director-level scope
No demonstrated experience influencing cloud product strategy or advising external strategic customers/partners

key_factors.factor: No director-level or strategic leadership track record
